name: OGX Quenching Plus Coconut Curls Shampoo 385ml | USA
description:
Product Name: OGX Quenching Plus Coconut Curls Shampoo
Quantity: 385ml
Origin: USA
Brand: Organix (OGX)

Key Features & Benefits

Curl Enhancing Formula: Defines, softens, and enhances curls for a smooth, bouncy look.

Deep Nourishment: Infused with Coconut Oil, Sweet Honey, and Citrus Oil to drench curls in hydration.

Frizz Control: Helps tame frizz while boosting natural spirals for a healthier appearance.

Color-Safe: Gentle formula, safe for color-treated hair.

Sulphate-Free: Free from harsh sulphates – a safe and effective surfactant hair care system.
